2015.why: It drew about a fifth as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about body structure.
2015.pln: about a fifth as many complaints as the average car
td: Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.
Fuel system
Watch for hard starts, stalling, hesitation or a fuel smell.

2016.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Seats
Adjust each seat, try any heaters, and make sure they lock in place.

2017.why: It drew a bit over half as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about brakes.
2017.pln: a bit over half as many complaints as the average car
td: Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
